stages.journal: The king doesn't dress it up: the passes above the city are getting bold. Trolls down off the scree, worgs running the shoulders where the shepherds used to graze. The Line started as a quarry foreman who paid other people's debts — it holds because someone still does the work. Clear the high ground. Both kinds.

Done, and the shepherds will know it before the court does. One formality left, and it isn't small: High Warden Maren keeps the castle and weighs who the Crown may trust. Present yourself to the Castellan. She made the one decision that can't be taken back; she does not rush the ones that can. Then return to the king.
